description: Free, no key. PazAIr has more tools than the list you were given: this finds them. Say what you want to do in a few words (e.g. "refund", "tender", "subscription", "licence", "report of my advertisement") and get the matching tools with their full definitions; call one with use_tool. Leave words out to get every tool by name with one line each.

limit.description: How many tools to return in full, 1 to 20. Default 8.

words.description: What you want to do, in a few words, e.g. dispute an order. Optional.

name: find_tools
